test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 19 Jun, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: P1 is 4 times as efficient as P2 and together they complete a work in 16 days. How many days will P1 alone take to complete the same work?
solution:
Given:-

P1 = 4 × P2

P1 + P2 = 16 days

Calculation:-

The ratio of efficiency of P1 and P2 = 4 ∶ 1 

The ratio of time taken is inversely proportional to the ratio of efficiency 

The ratio of time taken by P1 and P2 = 1 ∶ 4 

Total work = Efficiency × time taken

= 16 × 5

= 80 units

Time taken by P1 = 80/4 = 20 days

**The answer is 20 days.**
